Build is clean. The two real bugs exposed by the package bump were both in the link stage:

1. **`src/core/options.js:7`** — `resolveRetries` was looking for `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `options.retryCount`. Changed to read the right key.

2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js:8–10`** — `isBackoffEnabled` threw an error when it got `undefined` (the new config loader's default for unset flags), but it only expected `true` or `false`. Simplified to treat anything other than explicitly `true` as disabled.

The 8 remaining warnings are deprecation notices from the package updates (deprecated Node APIs and modules) — noise that doesn't block the build.

```
build finished in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors
```
